title: Check yourself: Two subagents and the tools each one gets

questions.stem: The audit of the draft prints `bare-write-allowed`. What removes that finding?

options.text: Giving the scaffolding subagent a tools line of its own, with a few names
options.says: Ruled out because that is a third: "`agent-inherits-all` and `agent-bare-bash`: a subagent with no `tools` line, or with the shell tool in it".

options.text: Adding the file-writing tool to the tools line of the subagent that generates the code
options.says: Ruled out because a tools line lists tools and approves nothing in settings: "The `tools` line is the allowlist."

options.text: Denying `Read(./.env)` in the same settings file as the allow rule
options.says: Ruled out because that is another finding: "`env-readable`: the settings do not deny `Read(./.env)`."

options.text: Replacing the whole-tool allow rule with one limited to `src/generated/`
options.says: The finding is about an allow rule that covers the whole tool: "`bare-write-allowed`: an allow rule that approves the whole `Edit` or `Write` tool."

origin.section: The audit: a checklist that reads the files

questions.stem: A boilerplate agent may change files only in `src/generated`. Which settings give that?

options.text: An allow rule for the Edit tool, limited to that folder
options.says: An Edit rule covers every built-in file-editing tool and a path keeps it to one folder.

options.text: An allow rule for the Write tool, limited to that folder
options.says: Ruled out because a Write path rule is never read: "A path rule written for the Write tool is accepted and never consulted".

options.text: An allow rule for the whole Edit tool, plus a prompt naming the folder
options.says: Ruled out because a bare rule has no path: "A bare `Edit` rule has no path and approves every edit."

options.text: A deny rule for the shell tool, since only commands can write
options.says: Ruled out because the file tools have rules of their own: "Denying the shell does not limit the file tools".

origin.section: Writing in one folder: the rule must be about Edit

questions.stem: A ticket server lets a caller fetch, add and remove tickets, and agents may only look at them. Which settings give that?

options.text: Deny the delete tool in the settings with a rule that matches on the ticket number
options.says: Ruled out because the rule is skipped: "In a settings file, a rule for an MCP tool that carries parentheses is skipped, so it matches nothing".

options.text: Allow every tool of the server, and tell the agents to read only
options.says: Ruled out because a sentence is no limit: "A sentence in the prompt is a request that the model weighs".

options.text: Allow the get tool by name, and deny the create and delete tools by name
options.says: Allow by name and deny the others by name.

options.text: Deny the whole server, then allow its get tool by name
options.says: Ruled out because a deny rule beats every allow: "A matching deny rule wins over any allow rule, whatever the specificity."

origin.section: MCP servers: one name in three places
